top10_exact_variant_eqtl.note: Exact-variant lookups used the nominated target from the primary analysis. Mismatched-target top-10 pairs provide a negative control.

mpra_exact_variant_note: One exact-variant macrophage MPRA positive control (ETS2); insufficient support for an AUROC estimate.
note: AUROC/AUPRC were calculated only for tasks with at least ten positive and ten negative labels. Sparse MPRA and Perturb-seq evidence is reported as coverage, not used to fabricate metrics.
